description: Run a tool on an input matching its input schema (see get_tool). Pay with payment_signature (x402 v2) or a pass api_key. Without either, returns HTTP 402 with payment_required describing the USDC payment.

api_key.description: API key of a 30-day pass for this tool.

input.description: Request body matching the tool input schema.

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value for this call.

name: run_tool
title: Run a tool
